sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P2, to 
be performed 
four years
as indicated by Y4 in the title block

The first draft initiated by eng.
Wagdy Mekhaiel Barsom and tested at
06 May 2003 at Malawy substation
132kv, ME zone.
Safety Precautions
A work Permit must be issued.

Switch off the circuit breaker and be sure that the pressure gauge pointer reads 
20 atm.
CB must be isolated and proper earthing at the two sides of the C.B is required.
Isolate control circuit (d.c voltage).
Safety fence with cautions marks around the work area is required.
Use only fiberglass ladders.
Wearing safety helmet is required.
Close the air stop cock in the distributing cabinet.

Open the drainage valve (13 fig 1) to drain the air out of the tank and be sure 
That the C.B is free of pressure

Personnel carrying out the maintenance should be trained and qualified or 
directly supervised by some one who is

 the complete arcing chamber in its previous position on the support insulator

 and put them in its position on the supporting isalator.
